quests.name: Blueleaf Tubers
quests.text: Grab a Crate with Holes. Grab a Snufflenose Command Stick. Grab and read the Snufflenose Owner's Manual.  In Razorfen Kraul, use the Crate with Holes to summon a Snufflenose Gopher, and use the Command Stick on the gopher to make it search for Tubers.  Bring 6 Blueleaf Tubers, the Snufflenose Command Stick and the Crate with Holes to Mebok Mizzyrix in Ratchet.
